title: Paul Mellon's walking stick

tellings.quote: I was told it was Paul Melon's washing stick.

plain: Harold Malmgren, an economist who advised several US presidents and says he handled UFO material himself, recalls being shown a walking stick in Virginia and being told it belonged to Paul Mellon, a very wealthy American banker's son and art collector. Malmgren repeats only what he was told, and gives nothing more about why the stick mattered.
